summary: The audit checks 45 units, at least 36 of them at the 200 level or above and none below the 100 level, with a C or better in every graded course: the core courses (COMPMED 205, 210, 211, 290 and 291 letter graded, and COMPMED 200 twice), one elective, and research units on the thesis track. Checked by hand: the 3.0 GPA and either the master's thesis and presentation or the non-thesis rotations with their deliverables. External credit is not accepted.

totals.why: Policies: "36 of 45 units must be 200-level or above"

totals.label: Courses below the 100 level
totals.why: Policies: "All courses must be taken at the 100 level or above"

w6vfxeck.why: "Students must complete a master's thesis" "Students must present their research to the department." "Non Thesis Option: Hands-on rotations will be done both within and outside of Stanford University. Instead of a final thesis, trainees in the non-thesis track will produce deliverables for each rotation". The overview adds for the non-thesis track "students should enroll in COMPMED 260 for rotation credit" and "Students will also participate in 3-4 quarters of hands-on rotations, for credit." The thesis and rotation tracks are alternatives.
